## Preparing the work space
### Setting up the working directory
```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
require("knitr")
opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/Figure3/")
options(bitmapType = "cairo")
```
### Loading required packages and scripts
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```
# Version 2: Precursors merged, mean, reference data from r105
## Mouse
```{r}
## Define list of species
species <- "Mouse"
nbin <- 24
ctrl <- 100
psgs <- c(
  "ENSMUSG00000108307-Ceacam-ps1",
  "ENSMUSG00000074272-Ceacam1",
  "ENSMUSG00000054385-Ceacam2",
  "ENSMUSG00000053228-Ceacam3",
  "ENSMUSG00000008789-Ceacam5",
  "ENSMUSG00000007209-Ceacam9",
  "ENSMUSG00000054169-Ceacam10",
  "ENSMUSG00000030368-Ceacam11",
  "ENSMUSG00000030366-Ceacam12",
  "ENSMUSG00000057195-Ceacam13",
  "ENSMUSG00000023185-Ceacam14",
  "ENSMUSG00000078795-Ceacam15",
  "ENSMUSG00000014686-Ceacam16",
  "ENSMUSG00000030472-Ceacam18",
  "ENSMUSG00000049848-Ceacam19",
  "ENSMUSG00000070777-Ceacam20",
  "ENSMUSG00000108558-Psg-ps1",
  "ENSMUSG00000066760-Psg16",
  "ENSMUSG00000004540-Psg17",
  "ENSMUSG00000003505-Psg18",
  "ENSMUSG00000004542-Psg19",
  "ENSMUSG00000063305-Psg20",
  "ENSMUSG00000070796-Psg21",
  "ENSMUSG00000044903-Psg22",
  "ENSMUSG00000074359-Psg23",
  "ENSMUSG00000070798-Psg25",
  "ENSMUSG00000070799-Psg26",
  "ENSMUSG00000070797-Psg27",
  "ENSMUSG00000030373-Psg28",
  "ENSMUSG00000023159-Psg29",
  "ENSMUSG00000078793-Gm5155")

## Loading the atlas
Atlas <- readRDS(paste0("../ReferenceFiles/Atlases/Trophoblast/", species, "TrophoblastAtlas_FinalVersion_26thMay2026.rds"))

## Adding a new classification for cell types
Atlas@meta.data$cell.type.for.modules <- Atlas@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell.type.for.modules = case_when(cell.type.short %in% c("precSTGC", "STGC") ~ "STGC",
                                                  cell.type.short %in% c("precSynTI", "SynTI") ~ "SynTI",
                                                  cell.type.short %in% c("precSynTII", "SynTII") ~ "SynTII",
                                                  cell.type.short %in% c("precSpT", "SpT") ~ "SpT",
                                                  .default = cell.type.short)) %>%
  pull(cell.type.for.modules)
Idents(Atlas) <- "cell.type.for.modules"

## Loading pre-computed sets of genes and scoring
module_files <- list.files(path = paste0("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/Figure3/ReferenceData/r106/", species),
                           pattern = "[0-9]\\.rds$",
                           full.names = TRUE)
module_lists <- lapply(X = module_files, FUN = readRDS)
names(module_lists) <- gsub(pattern = ".rds", replacement = '', x = gsub(pattern = ".*_", replacement = '', x = module_files))

## Make a look-up table for ENSEMBL_ID <--> Atlas_name
lookup_table <- rownames(Atlas) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::rename("atlas_gene_name" = ".") %>%
  dplyr::mutate("ensembl_id" = gsub(pattern = "-.*", replacement = "", x = atlas_gene_name))

## Lists
module_lists <- lapply(module_lists, FUN = function(x) x %>% pull(ensembl_gene_id))

## Subset to genes present in the atlas
modules_to_be_scored <- lapply(X = module_lists, FUN = function(x) lookup_table %>%
         dplyr::filter(ensembl_id %in% x) %>%
         pull(atlas_gene_name))
names(modules_to_be_scored) <- names(module_lists)

## Sanity check: what fraction of modules are we loosing due to genes not being captured
sanity_check <- data.frame(module = names(module_lists),
fraction_found = sapply(modules_to_be_scored, length) / sapply(module_lists, length),
row.names = NULL)
print(sanity_check)

## Scoring the modules
for (i in seq_along(modules_to_be_scored)) {
  Atlas <- AddModuleScore(Atlas,
                          features = list(modules_to_be_scored[[i]]),
                          name = names(modules_to_be_scored)[i],
                          nbin = nbin,
                          ctrl = ctrl)
}

## Module 8: Pregnancy-specific glycoproteins
Atlas <- AddModuleScore(Atlas, list(psgs), name = "PSG_Ceacam", nbin = nbin, ctrl = ctrl)

score_cols <- tail(colnames(Atlas@meta.data), length(modules_to_be_scored)+1)
  
mean_scores <- Atlas@meta.data %>%
  group_by(cell.type.for.modules) %>%     # your cell type identity column
  summarise(across(all_of(score_cols), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-cell.type.for.modules, names_to = "module", values_to = "mean_score")

mean_scores <- mean_scores %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  mutate(z_score = as.numeric(scale(mean_score))) %>%
  ungroup()

mean_scores$module <- sub("1$", "", mean_scores$module)

## Save data
write.table(x = mean_scores, file = paste0("Data/r106/", species,"_nbin", nbin, "_nctrl", ctrl, "_precursorsmerged_meanscores.txt"))

## Emptying the environment
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r}
  group_by(cell.type.for.modules) %>%     # your cell type identity column
  summarise(across(all_of(score_cols), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-cell.type.for.modules, names_to = "module", values_to = "mean_score")

mean_scores <- mean_scores %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  mutate(z_score = as.numeric(scale(mean_score))) %>%
  ungroup()

mean_scores$module <- sub("1$", "", mean_scores$module)

## Save data
write.table(x = mean_scores, file = paste0("Data/r106/", species,"_nbin", nbin, "_nctrl", ctrl, "_precursorsmerged_meanscores.txt"))

## Emptying the environment
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r}
mouse <- read.table(file = "Data/r106/Mouse_nbin24_nctrl100_precursorsmerged_meanscores.txt")

rat <- read.table(file = "Data/r106/Rat_nbin24_nctrl100_precursorsmerged_meanscores.txt")
rat$species <- "Rat"

human <- read.table(file = "Data/r106/Human_nbin24_nctrl100_precursorsmerged_meanscores.txt")
human$species <- "Human"

marmoset <- read.table(file = "Data/r106/Marmoset_nbin24_nctrl100_precursorsmerged_meanscores.txt")
marmoset$species <- "Marmoset"

rabbit <- read.table(file = "Data/r106/Rabbit_nbin24_nctrl100_precursorsmerged_meanscores.txt")

guineapig <- read.table(file = "Data/r106/GuineaPig_nbin24_nctrl100_precursorsmerged_meanscores.txt")
guineapig$species <- "Guinea Pig"

## Combining and reordering
dfs <- rbind(mouse, rat, human, marmoset, rabbit, guineapig)

## Assigning module name to GO id
dfs <- dfs %>%
    dplyr::mutate(module_names = case_when(module == "GO.0002682" ~ "Regulation of immune system process",
                                           module == "GO.0005179" ~ "Hormone activity",
                                           module == "GO.0006865" ~ "Amino acid transport",
                                           module == "GO.0006869" ~ "Lipid transport",
                                           module == "GO.0008643" ~ "Carbohydrate transport",
                                           module == "GO.0048514" ~ "Blood vessel morphogenesis",
                                           module == "GO.0046879" ~ "Hormone secretion",
                                           module == "GO.0120178" ~ "Steroid hormone biosynthetic process",
                                           module == "PSG_Ceacam" ~ "Module: PSG & CEACAM"))

## Reordering
dfs$species <- factor(x = dfs$species, levels = c("Human", "Marmoset", "Rabbit", "Guinea Pig", "Rat", "Mouse"))
dfs$module_names <- factor(x = dfs$module_names, levels = c("Amino acid transport",
                                                            "Carbohydrate transport",
                                                            "Lipid transport",
                                                            "Steroid hormone biosynthetic process",
                                                            "Hormone secretion",
                                                            "Hormone activity",
                                                            "Module: PSG & CEACAM",
                                                            "Regulation of immune system process",
                                                            "Blood vessel morphogenesis"))
dfs$cell.type.for.modules <- factor(x = dfs$cell.type.for.modules, levels = rev(c("STB",
                                                                  "SynTI",
                                                                  "SynTII",
                                                                  "precPTGC",
                                                                  "STGC",
                                                                  "SpT",
                                                                  "CTB",
                                                                  "TrophProg",
                                                                  "LaTP",
                                                                   "JZTP",
                                                                  "EVT",
                                                                  "GlyT",
                                                                  "InvTroph",
                                                                  "SpATGC")))


p1 <- ggplot(dfs, aes(x = module_names,
           y = cell.type.for.modules,
           fill = z_score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~species,
             ncol = 3,
             scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Average module score (scaled)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 70,
                               hjust = 1,
                               vjust = 1),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "cm"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 45),
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/r106/6species_MeanScores_PrecursorsMerged_nbin24_nctrl100.png", plot = p1, width = 14, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/r106/6species_MeanScores_PrecursorsMerged_nbin24_nctrl100.pdf", plot = p1, width = 14, height = 10)
```
